follow smr partOf_mountainrange_mountainrange mountainrange as parent_mr
follow parent_mr partOf_mountain_mountainrange mountain as m
return m.name order by m.elevation_m desc limit 1
460e4bd4-f2ae-4ad9-a43a-4123bfef5179:
find organization as org
follow org basedIn location as loc
count distinct loc as n
return n
710ef20c-d1ea-4521-ac34-2fb9f23312e2:
find river where name = "Lukaya River" as r
follow r partOf_river_drainagebasin drainagebasin as db_r
find lake where name = "Lake Mweru" as l
follow l partOf_lake_drainagebasin drainagebasin as db_l
return db_r.name, db_l.name
63f60dba-c276-412c-9f8a-45d9aa6d3b28:
find position where name = "swingman" as pos
follow pos playsPosition player as p
follow p receivesAward award as a
group by p as g
count distinct g.a as num_awards
return p.name, num_awards
1a362a72-8818-458e-a676-ea0fe100a795:
find flightaccident where name contains "West Caribbean Airways Flight 9955" as f
follow f departsFrom airport as a
return a.name, a.icao_code
49847861-43ef-45ee-8796-a315f611a75c:
find company as c
follow c hasBoardMember person as p
max c.launch_year as latest_year
return latest_year
4aeb1185-5b06-422d-a5fe-f0c78553915d:
find person where name = "Ho Yi" as p
return p.gender
182dd6a8-8a4d-4489-a09b-f44087456e47:
find country where name = "Madagascar" as c
follow c releasedIn movie as m
follow m producedBy productioncompany as pc
return pc.name
352b46b5-0175-4f9a-81e4-a4bb5619f30e:
find person where name = "Quentin Tarantino" as p
follow p hasCastMember movie as m
follow m writtenBy person as w
group by m as g
count distinct g.w as writer_count
return m.name, writer_count
bd693706-3c08-43c7-a0ea-8b33cd2f910f:
find country where name = "People's Republic of China" as c
follow c locatedIn_lake_country lake as l
follow l partOf_lake_drainagebasin drainagebasin as db
return db.name
0ef793f7-1a2d-4dc7-8b8d-0942c32c08c6:
find flightaccident where name = "Avianca Flight 671" as avianca
follow avianca departsFrom airport as dep_airport
follow dep_airport destinedFor flightaccident where date > "1975-06-24" as dest_accidents
return dest_accidents.name
